text.body: || ādityahṛdayam nāmāvaliḥ || oṃ raśmimate namaḥ | oṃ samudyate namaḥ | oṃ devāsuranamaskṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ vivasvate namaḥ | oṃ bhāskarāya namaḥ | 5| oṃ bhuvaneśvarāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvadevātmakāya namaḥ | oṃ tejasvine namaḥ | oṃ raśmibhavanāya namaḥ | oṃ devāsuragaṇalokapālāya namaḥ | 10| oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ | oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ | oṃ śivāya namaḥ | oṃ skandāya namaḥ | oṃ prajāpataye namaḥ | 15| oṃ mahendrāya namaḥ | oṃ dhanadāya namaḥ | oṃ kālāya namaḥ | oṃ yamāya namaḥ | oṃ somāya namaḥ | 20| oṃ apāṃpataye namaḥ | oṃ pitṛmūrtaye namaḥ | oṃ vasumūrtaye namaḥ | oṃ sādhyamūrtaye namaḥ | oṃ aśvimūrtaye namaḥ | 25| oṃ marunmūrtaye namaḥ | oṃ manave namaḥ | oṃ vāyumūrtaye namaḥ | oṃ vahnaye namaḥ | oṃ prajamūrtaye namaḥ | 30| oṃ prāṇāya namaḥ | oṃ ṛtave namaḥ | oṃ kartre namaḥ | oṃ prabhākarāya namaḥ | oṃ ādityāya namaḥ | 35| oṃ savitre namaḥ | oṃ sūryāya namaḥ | oṃ khagāya namaḥ | oṃ pūṣṇe namaḥ | oṃ gabhastimate namaḥ | 40| oṃ suvarṇasadṛśāya namaḥ | oṃ bhānave namaḥ | oṃ hiraṇyaretase namaḥ | oṃ divākarāya namaḥ | oṃ haridaśvāya namaḥ | 45| oṃ sahasrārciṣe namaḥ | oṃ saptasaptaye namaḥ | oṃ marīcimate namaḥ | oṃ timironmathanāya namaḥ | oṃ śaṃbhave namaḥ | 50| oṃ tvaṣṭre namaḥ | oṃ mārtāṇḍāya namaḥ | oṃ aṃśumate namaḥ | oṃ hiraṇyagarbhāya namaḥ | oṃ śiśirāya namaḥ | 55| oṃ tapanāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāskarāya namaḥ | oṃ ravaye namaḥ | oṃ agnigarbhāya namaḥ | oṃ aditeḥputrāya namaḥ | 60| oṃ śaṃkhāya namaḥ | oṃ śiśiranāśanāya namaḥ | oṃ vyomanāthāya namaḥ | oṃ tamobhedine namaḥ | oṃ ṛgyajuḥsāmapāragāya namaḥ | 65| oṃ ghanavṛṣṭaye namaḥ | oṃ apāṃmitrāya namaḥ | oṃ vindhyavīthīplavaṅgamāya namaḥ | oṃ ātapine namaḥ | oṃ maṇḍaline namaḥ | 70| oṃ mṛtyave namaḥ | oṃ piṅgalāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvatāpanāya namaḥ | oṃ kavaye namaḥ | oṃ viśvasmai namaḥ | 75| oṃ mahātejase namaḥ | oṃ raktāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvabhavodbhavāya namaḥ | oṃ nakṣatragrahatārāṇāṃ adhipāya namaḥ | oṃ viśvabhāvanāya namaḥ | 80| oṃ tejasāmapi tejasvine namaḥ | oṃ dvādaśātmane namaḥ | oṃ indrāya namaḥ | oṃ dhātre namaḥ | oṃ bhagāya namaḥ | 85| oṃ pūṣṇe namaḥ | oṃ mitrāya namaḥ | oṃ varuṇāya namaḥ | oṃ aryamaṇe namaḥ | oṃ arciṣmate namaḥ | 90| oṃ vivasvate namaḥ | oṃ tvaṣṭre namaḥ | oṃ savitre namaḥ | oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ | oṃ pūrvāyagiraye namaḥ | 95| oṃ paścimāyādraye namaḥ | oṃ jyotirgaṇānāṃpataye namaḥ | oṃ dinādhipataye namaḥ | oṃ jayāya namaḥ | oṃ jayabhadrāya namaḥ | 100| oṃ haryaśvāya namaḥ | oṃ sahasrāṃśave namaḥ | oṃ ādityāya namaḥ | oṃ ugrāya namaḥ | oṃ vīrāya namaḥ | 105| oṃ sāraṃgāya namaḥ | oṃ padmaprabodāya namaḥ | oṃ pracaṇḍāya namaḥ | oṃ brahmeśānācyuteśāya namaḥ | oṃ sūryāya namaḥ | 110| oṃ ādityavarcase namaḥ | oṃ bhāsvate namaḥ | oṃ sarvabhakṣāya namaḥ | oṃ raudraya vapuṣe namaḥ | oṃ tamoghnāya namaḥ | 115| oṃ himaghnāya namaḥ | oṃ śatrughnāya namaḥ | oṃ amitātmane namaḥ | oṃ kṛtaghnaghnāya namaḥ | oṃ devāya namaḥ | 120| oṃ jyotiṣāṃpataye namaḥ | oṃ taptacāmīkarābhāya namaḥ | oṃ vahnaye namaḥ | oṃ viśvakarmaṇe namaḥ | oṃ tamobhinighnāya namaḥ | 125| oṃ ghṛṇaye namaḥ | oṃ lokasākṣiṇe namaḥ | oṃ bhūtasrṣṭre namaḥ | oṃ bhūtapālāya namaḥ | oṃ bhūtanāśāya namaḥ | 130| oṃ pāyate namaḥ | oṃ tapate namaḥ | oṃ varṣate namaḥ | oṃ supteṣu jāgrate namaḥ | oṃ bhūteṣu pariniṣṭhitāya namaḥ | 135| oṃ agnihotrāya namaḥ | oṃ agnihotriṇāṃ phalāya namaḥ | oṃ paramasamarthāya parabrahmaṇe namaḥ | 138|
